The same intelligence. A smaller bill.

Enso routes each answer to the right model. Kai answers a decision directly.

Enso vs frontier LLMs · GPQA Diamond
up to 14.2× lessper 1,000 questions, at higher accuracyEnso Flash answers 90.6% of new GPQA Diamond questions at $3.26 per 1,000 — higher accuracy than Claude Fable 5.1 (87.9% at $46.25). Enso reaches 93.7% at $10.03, ahead of the best single model (93.1%).
